input: Registered CameraAdapter implementations. Adapters receive already read documents; no OS paths or I/O.
output: Adapter lookup by index reader id, index readers for the scanner, per-pattern metadata sufficiency (Declared: never probe; NeedsProbe: one probe in Ingest).
adapter_granularity: one adapter per camera catalog pattern (camera and record layout), never per manufacturer; shared vendor parsing stays in public libraries such as qnc-sony-metadata
